info.title: Korean Learner's Dictionary API
info.description: 56,000+ Korean headwords (words, idioms, proverbs) with Korean definitions, 590K+ example sentences, and translations in 11 languages (en, zh, ja, fr, es, ar, mn, vi, th, id, ru). Search in Korean or in any of the 11 languages. Levels: beginner / intermediate / advanced. Hanja origin included. Data © National Institute of Korean Language (2026-08 release), CC BY-SA 2.0 KR.

get.summary: Search words (Korean or any of 11 languages)
get.description: Search by Korean headword or by a word in any of the 11 translation languages. Exact matches and basic words come first. Filter by level and part of speech; paginate with page and per_page.
